The investigation traced seven distinct blockchain entities linked to the seed wallet 0x8b85752cc9ae2fd426e0b52396e9856fb23b14eb. Six transfers were confirmed and one inferred correlation was identified, resulting in a total of seven transfers across a maximum depth of three hops. Four of these transfers met or exceeded the 30 % reporting threshold, while three were below it. The seed wallet carries a risk score of 20 / 100 (LOW), with an indicator of proximity to a known scam cluster contributing +20 points at hop depth 0.

Across the traced network, the highest‑scoring entities are the seed wallet itself, 0x989e71bfb5ac158dc74806c2ea76f57dc2752091 and 0xe7487955bc48390f49de515c54cd2df63f4d6b18, each also rated 20 / 100 (LOW). The movement of the reported loss of INR 1,85,000, occurring on 2026‑09‑01 at 11:04 IST, is confined to the identified transfers and does not extend beyond the seven entities examined.
